text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm...
I guess it really won't be that easy to find...
Noticing Zenno Rob Roy letting out a soft sigh, I asked her what was the matter.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A-Actually, I'm looking for the owner of this bookmark...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was tucked inside a book I borrowed.
I thought it might belong to the previous reader...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Seeing such a pretty pressed-flower bookmark,
I'm sure they must really love books.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Once that crossed my mind,
I felt I truly had to return the bookmark to its owner.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm an avid reader of that hidden masterpiece,
'Run, Umus,' hehe.
choice_data_list: Maybe you should check with the library committee.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, well, the library committee member... is me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Or rather... That's it! The checkout ledger records! Her name should be in there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Using Zenno Rob Roy's library committee clearance, we accessed the lending ledger data and identified the Umamusume who had checked out the book.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
After that, if we ask people starting from the most recent checkout dates,
we should be able to find the owner of the bookmark...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Searching the entire academy sounds like quite an ordeal, though――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited to meet someone
who's read the same book!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it would be lovely if we could talk about our thoughts on the book...♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's a youth story full of sweat and tears about Umamusume competing in medium-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To give you a quick synopsis, the protagonist, Umass,
is an innocent, gentle-hearted Umamusume. But she's awkward with words
and often misunderstood, always left all alone during practice...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even an Umamus like her made one single best friend.
Unlike her, this friend was cheerful, popular, and full of promise for the future...
choice_data_list: (She started going off at top speed!?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
However, one day, tragedy struck her best friend.
A sudden accident left her with severe injuries, never able to race again...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Upon her retirement, she said to Omasu...
'From now on, please run carrying my dreams with you.'

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... ugh... *sniff*... This is one of the greatest scenes
in the whole work, just remembering it brings tears to my eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And thus, Umasu inherited her best friend's dream
of conquering the Autumn Senior Triple Crown――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
How was it?
It is a favorite story of mine, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please do give it a read!
I'd be thrilled if we could share our thoughts on it afterwards!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy's eyes sparkled with starry wonder.
